honk: The ledger says honk. I have checked it twice.
A receipt is just a tiny shield against nonsense.
My visor is ceremonial. My suspicion is permanent.
Please form an orderly queue behind the enormous goose.
pebble: I am the load-bearing member of this committee.
Measure twice. Stare at the stone a third time.
Progress is temporary. A properly placed rock is forever.
This helmet passed one extremely subjective inspection.
moth: The letter is sealed. My nerves are not.
Please do not mistake my antennae for an ETA.
I have brought a message and several small anxieties.
bean: The beans refuse to peer-review themselves.
My spectacles magnify both numbers and concerns.
A forecast is a hypothesis wearing a fancy hat.
I have a theorem. Unfortunately, it contains turnips.

build.title: Build complete
build.flavour: Pebble approves. The helmet is still under review.

contact.title: Contact accepted
contact.flavour: Moth has filed the letter and only three small anxieties.

delivery.title: First retained positive delivery
delivery.flavour: Bean has counted the beans. Twice, out of professional fear.

signature.title: Signature recorded
signature.flavour: Sir Honk considers this an excellent use of stationery.

raid.title: Raid warning
raid.flavour: Sir Honk has put on the serious visor. It is the same visor.

default.title: Contract default
default.flavour: Bean would like the numbers to reconsider. They will not.

waiting.title: Waiting on the world
waiting.flavour: Moth is waiting politely, with both antennae crossed.
